resources.string: Optional local learning from explicit choices only. Up to 512 distinct records are kept outside backups. Disabling collection stops new examples; Reset removes saved examples and patterns. A fixed fifth of expected words is reserved for testing and never trains patterns. Results compare local suggestions on normalized words, excluding model, touch and exact-pair personalization; this is not automatic editing accuracy. Small or empty samples do not establish accuracy.
